bigPicture.purpose: Users upload a supplier invoice / checklist (PDF, Excel or XML). The system extracts header, invoice, item and container data, enriches it from local masters (duty notifications, HS/CTH, scheme codes, country/port, exchange rate), lets the user edit it in a grid, then creates a customs job (Import Bill of Entry or Export Shipping Bill) in the company database.
commonPattern: 1. Page_Load: aps.checkSession(); read Session (user, branch, working period, COMPANY_ID, license, transport mode); bind importer/exporter dropdown; AUTO_JOBNO().
2. Preview click (btnPrevData_Click): validate file count (per-company limit), save file under ~/Submission/<Import|Export>PDFReader/, count PDF pages (iTextSharp), pick extraction vendor, call it.
3. Normalise extractor output into DataTables (invoice / item / container / IGM), apply per-client rules, look up masters (duty, IGST, AIDC, UQC, country, port).
4. Bind grid (paged, 100 rows/page) with ViewState DataTables; user edits, bulk-applies (Apply to All), filters by invoice/item/RITC, deletes rows.

5. Upload click (btnupload_Click): re-read grid, validate mandatory fields on ALL pages, insert General -> Invoice -> Item -> IGM -> Container via Transaction/Import_PDF_Upload/Export_PDF_Upload business objects.
6. Log each step to PDF_AI_COUNT_DETAILS (PageCount_log) and to file log via PDFReaderLog (WriteOcrJobLog).

extractionEngines.1_AI_synchronous: Import_PDF_Reader_AI / Import_Checklist_Reader_AI / Export_PDF_Reader_New_AI call an HTTP OCR/AI service and wait for the JSON result in the same request.
extractionEngines.2_AI_asynchronous_queue: Export_PDF_Reader_New_AI with vendor PMDG posts the file to the EROYAL (portal-eroyal.pmdgtech.com) workflow engine, gets a processInstanceId, saves a queue row and returns immediately. The AI_Extraction_Queue screen polls EROYAL and stores the OCR JSON; the user later opens the Export AI screen with ?pid= to review and save.
extractionEngines.3_template_mapping_Excel: Import_Excel_Reader (native .xlsx via ClosedXML) and Export_PDF_Reader_New (PDF converted to xlsx by Aspose then read by ACE OLEDB) use a per-customer JSON mapping stored in IMPORT_PDF_LKUP / EXPORT_PDF_LKUP (column label + row/col offsets + split rules) to pull header/invoice/item values from sheet cells.
extractionEngines.4_rule_based_text_parse: Export_PDF_Reader (LIZMA customers S.P.APPARELS, KPR SUGAR) and Imp_Inv_Item_Pdf_Reader (Vestas, Suzuki) parse iTextSharp text line by line with hardcoded keywords.
extractionEngines.5_XML_import: Export_XML_JSON_Reader loads a pre-built XML (DataSet.ReadXml) with EXPORTER/CONSIGNEE/INVOICE/ITEM tables; no extraction.
extractionEngines.6_legacy_OCR_service: Import_PDFReader (v1) posts to http://ec2-3-87-226-16.compute-1.amazonaws.com:9000/ocr_service and maps to a fixed item grid; saved items are filled entirely from the product master (Select_Whole_Data).

DataKeys: QUEUE_ID, PROCESS_ID, VENDOR_TYPE, STATUS, SL_NO, IMPORTER_NAME, JOB_TYPE.

flow: Page_Load(!PostBack): calendars limited to today, job type default IMP, LoadSummaryCounts(), GridBind(1).

AutoCheckAllInProgressRows: Queue_Grid_Data with status 'IN PROGRESS', page 1 size 99999; for each row CheckJobStatus(processId, vendorType); FAILED -> Queue_Update_Status(FAILED); READY and vendor != EROYAL -> Queue_Update_Status(READY). EROYAL READY is stored inside CheckStatus_Eroyal itself.

CheckStatus_Eroyal: POST {field:'processInstanceId', value:pid, matchType:'exact'} to .../designer/api/datatable/getDataByField/dt_eroyaldb with x-api-key; count==0 -> IN PROGRESS; doc.Status=='Extraction_InProgress' -> IN PROGRESS; Status=='Completed' && ocrReady -> if ocrResult non-empty call Queue_Update_Status(pid,'READY', ocrResult) and return READY; anything else -> FAILED; any exception -> FAILED.
CheckStatus_Royal: ROYAL_STATUS_URL is empty so it always returns IN PROGRESS.

gvQueue_RowCommand: CommandArgument = PROCESS_ID~VENDOR_TYPE~SL_NO~IMPORTER_NAME~JOB_TYPE. 'CheckStatus' = check + Queue_Update_Status(status, ''). 'ViewResult' = opens popup (window.open 1200x700) to ../Export_PDFReader/Export_PDF_Reader_New_AI.aspx?pid=... for EXP, or ../Import_Pdf_Reader/Import_PDF_Reader_AI.aspx?pid=... for IMP, plus &vendor=&Imp_exp_name=&slno=.
gvQueue_RowDataBound: Draft vs Job Saved from JOB_NO (empty or StartsWith 'TEMP' = Draft); file/importer text truncated at 25 chars with tooltip.
businessObjectCalls: AI_Queue.Queue_Grid_Data(Global_variables A1 jobNo,A3 vendor,A6 status,A8 from,A9 to,A10 jobType,A11 page,A12 size)

Export_PDFReader/Export_PDF_Reader_New_A.role: Main Export AI screen: preview (sync or queued), review grid, create Shipping Bill job. 5236 lines.
Export_PDFReader/Export_PDF_Reader_New_A.vendorSelection: checkvendor() -> Admin_Premium_Services_Select(get_vendor_details, JobType 'E') returns VENDOR + PDF_UPLOAD. Vendors handled: Local (test .txt from Submission/ExportPDFReader/Local_Test), PMDG (EROYAL queue), Docker_Vision / empty (Gen_AI_PDF.Get_AccessToken_Invoice_Upload sync). A vendor 'Royal' is not handled on Export.
previewFlow: btnPrevData_Click: per-company file limit (default 5; 2118/293=15; 829=30; 6002=40; 3352/3267=50); save each upload to ~/Submission/ExportPDFReader/; get page count; split ddl_ExporterName 'slno--name'; Get_PdfClientName (FETCH_PDF_CLIENT_NAME); checkvendor().
Sync vendors: ds_API = vendor result DataSet (Local/Docker) then Getting_Mater_Details().

PMDG: collect all uploaded files, page-count total, FireAndForget_Eroyal(filePaths, fileNames, exp_name) -> processId. If processId: PageCount_log(PREVIEW_INITIATED), Insert_Queue_Record(processId, fileName, exporter, 'EROYAL', branchSlno, pdfClientName, pdfId), Alert_And_Redirect_Queue() which calls parent.openAistatuscheck('EXP'); then return (no grid). If empty processId: 'Failed to submit job to Eroyal'.
Export_PDFReader/Export_PDF_Reader_New_A.queuedResultFlow: Opened from the queue as ?pid=&vendor=EROYAL&slno=&Imp_exp_name=. Page_Load(!PostBack): Bind_Clients(exp_name, slno) locks the exporter dropdown to 'slno--name'; if vendor=='EROYAL' reads stored JSON via QueueBO.Queue_Get_By_ProcessId(A4=pid).JSON_RESPONSE, Convert_Eroyal_To_Royal_Format(), ConvertJsonToDataSet(), then Getting_Mater_Details(). The live re-fetch Get_Eroyal_API_Output is commented out and never called.
Export_PDFReader/Export_PDF_Reader_New_A.FireAndForget_Eroyal: Reads every file into base64, builds JSON array [{fileName,fileBase64}] serialized to a STRING inside processVariables.files, plus fileName (single name or 'Merged_'+first) and userid; POST to EROYAL_UPLOAD_URL (60s timeout, no API key header); returns jsonArr[0].processInstance.id. Any exception is only logged and '' is returned.
Export_PDFReader/Export_PDF_Reader_New_A.Convert_Eroyal_To_Royal_Format: Accepts object or array OCR JSON; per invoice keeps Header (always an array), ItemsDetails and ShipmentContainerDetails; drops items whose ItemDesc is blank or numeric; Quantity to string; fills ItemSlNo 1..n per invoice when missing. Output is a JSON array of invoice objects.
Export_PDFReader/Export_PDF_Reader_New_A.ConvertJsonToDataSet: Merges all invoices into three DataTables Header(0), ItemsDetails(1), ShipmentContainerDetails(2, only added if it has rows).
Export_PDFReader/Export_PDF_Reader_New_A.Getting_Mater_Details: Requires Header[0].Status == 'Success'. Fills exporter/consignee (cut to 100 chars)/buyer (35 chars, 'SAME AS CONSIGNEE' fallback)/notify party/country+port (validated via OCR_PDF_PORT_MASTER VALIDATE_PORT_COUNTRY)/IEC (falls back to Import_Details_Bind master)/AdCode; builds invoice table (one row per Header row, terms normalised e.g. CFR->CF, DAP/DDP->CIF, EXW->FOB) and container table; then loops items building dt_gvew with per-company / per-exporter rules (companies 816, 2118, 579, 3305, 1509, 470, 139, 6002, 293, exporters BRAKES INDIA, DENSO KIRLOSKAR, MAF CLOTHING, STRIDES, MOTHER INDIA FORMING...). Master lookup erm.RetrieveAll_Export_PDF_Settings_MASTER (Get_Master_Data or Get_Master_Data_HS_DBK) supplies scheme, STR, reward, RODTEP, cess, end use, PTA/FTA, IGST, DBK slno/unit and the list of RITC/CTH candidates (CTH_List JSON: 1 = auto-fill, >1 = leave blank for autocomplete). PDF_Master_Mode 'S' (hidden default) skips master values.
Export_PDFReader/Export_PDF_Reader_New_A.saveFlow: btnupload_Click: reads ds_xl_Output from ViewState; master-or-extracted consignee and buyer (CleanExportField: ASCII 32-126 only, upper, max 100); BindgridViewData() validates every row on every page (desc, qty, 3-char qty code, end use, unit price, amount, PTA/FTA, 8-digit RITC); builds Dt_gen, Dt_Invoice (single or multi invoice with recomputed invoice value from item amounts), container table, annexure (sea/air defaults from OCR_ANNEXURE_DEFAULT_MASTER + many company overrides), Dt_Item (SQC/UQC via Get_CTH_Info_Uqc, INFO MSR rules), drawback rows (DRAWBACK_MASTER_ALL_Excel_Upload); AUTO_JOBNO(); exp_pdf.Exp_PDF_Upload_New_XML_AI(...flag 'Insert_Desc'); if result==1 then QueueBO.Job_No_Update(A1=job no, A2=pid) links the queue row to the job, sets Session JOBIDexcel and shows the checklist popup.
Export_PDFReader/Export_PDF_Reader_New_A.gridHelpers: Paged grid (100/page) backed by ViewState['GridViewData'] and ViewState['dt_Item']; SaveCurrentPageToDataTable on page change; Apply to All (btn_bulk_Update_All_Click); filters by Invoice/Item/RITC/Empty-RITC (ddl_Select_ItemRITC); Add Row; Delete Rows (re-sequences ItemSlNo per invoice); Excel download of PDF_AI_COUNT_DETAILS for a few hard-coded users (RTS, s, k, Aji).
Export_PDFReader/Export_PDF_Reader_New_A.logging: PageCount_log -> ds_Page.OCR_PDF_COUNT_UPDATE_INSERT with statuses PREVIEW INITIATED / PREVIEW SUCCESS / PREVIEW FAILED / UPLOAD INITIATED / UPLOAD SUCCESS / UPLOAD FAILED; WriteJobLog -> PDFReaderLog.WriteOcrJobLog(jobNo, stage, message, 'EXP'); page-refresh and close-button PageMethods.

Import_Pdf_Reader/Import_PDF_Reader_AI.a.role: Main Import AI screen (synchronous). Creates Bill of Entry job. 4319 lines.
Import_Pdf_Reader/Import_PDF_Reader_AI.a.vendorSelection: checkvendor() -> Admin_Premium_Services_Select(get_vendor_details, type 'I'); default 'Royal' if no row or error. Branches: Local (test file), Royal (UploadPdfExtraction -> http://www.ocrapiservice.royaltechsystems.co.in/api/invoice/royaltechocr, ApiKey 'Royal'), Docker_Vision/empty (UploadPdfWithParameters -> Nordex uses the royaltechocr service, everyone else https://asia-south1-serene-essence-419307.cloudfunctions.net/royal-invoice, ApiKey '12345'). Import_Pdf_Reader/Import_PDF_Reader_AI.a.previewFlow: btnPrevData_Click -> Get_Upload_File: per file save, PdfReader page count, importer/branch split from 'slno--name', Get_PdfClient_Name (FETCH_IMP_PDF_CLIENT_NAME), multipart POST (CompanyID, UserID, BranchCode, JobNo, JobType 'IMP', WorkingPeriod, PdfClientName...), JSON -> DataSet. Requires tables 0,1,2 non-empty. Then FillHeaderFields, FillInvoiceRows, FillIGMAndContainerRows, ProcessItemsBatch.
Import_Pdf_Reader/Import_PDF_Reader_AI.a.ProcessItemsBatch: Pre-fetches AIDC and IGST notifications per unique HS code, then for each item: country resolution (cached), European number swap for listed importers/clients, ApplyClientOverrides (~35 client-specific description/qty/rate rules), SetMasterLookupStrategy (Get_Master_Data / _PartNo / _CTH / _PartNo_VSM / BullsEye_Ritc / PartNo_Para by company), caches master results per key, fills BCD/SW/AIDC/IGST/UQC/END_USE; adds rows to Dt_Item (about 60 columns). PDF_Master_Mode 'S' (hidden default) ignores the item master.
Import_Pdf_Reader/Import_PDF_Reader_AI.a.saveFlow: btnupload_Click -> SaveCurrentPageToDataTable -> BindgridViewData (validates every row: desc, 8-digit CTH, AIDC, IGST unless company 151, manufacturer, end use, country, 3-char qty code, rate, amount, qty) -> insert_update: General (Transact.General_details_insertupdate), Invoice(s) (InsertInvoiceDetails with exchange rate cache, freight 20% and insurance 1.125% defaults for FOB/CI/CF), Items (Transact.Item_Details_insertupdate per row, or Import_PDF_Upload.Ocr_Import_Xml_Converter as one XML for companies 268 and 10), IGM and Container rows. Job number via GENERAL_DETAILS_SP_AUTOID. After success the parent screen is refreshed (General_Details_Update).
Import_Pdf_Reader/Import_PDF_Reader_AI.a.queueLink: ViewResult in the queue routes IMP jobs here with ?pid=, but this page never reads Request.QueryString (only the Export page does).

Import_Pdf_Reader/Import_Checklist_Reade.role: Reads an import CHECKLIST PDF (JobType 'che-imp') so that duty notification data extracted from the checklist (BCD, SW, AIDC, IGST notn/slno/rate) pre-fills items. Adds IGM (MBL/HBL), container and bond tables (Tables[3], Tables[4] ItemsIGMSBondDetails). BE type 'Warehouse'. Company 10 and 100 use local test files under Submission/ImportChecklistReader/Local_Test. Same AI endpoint as Import AI. Logs usage to PDF_AI_COUNT_DETAILS using concatenated raw SQL and mode 'ICH'.

Import_Pdf_Reader/Import_Excel_Reader.as.role: Reads customer Excel packing/invoice files (up to 5, 10 for companies 576/584).
Import_Pdf_Reader/Import_Excel_Reader.as.flow: ClosedXML reads each visible non-empty sheet into DataTable 'ColumnN' (strips circled digits); getCustInvDetls_Excel_Datatable(importer, path, sheets) -> getlkupval() loads the mapping JSON from IMPORT_PDF_LKUP (Importer_Name, Invo_Type 'S', del_flg=0) -> readHeaderPDFval / readinvoDetailPDFval / readDetailPDFval. Mapping rule per field: search cell text ('column'), move Position rows and Col_Pos columns (Reverse flips), optional split with Value index. Item table: find header row via range.start, read rows until 3 consecutive empty cells, then map columns by 'assign' (contains match). Companies 876/427/207 use a single-invoice model and 876/427 also merge N.W(KG) from the packing sheet. Rest of the pipeline (master lookup, grid, insert_update) mirrors Import AI.

Import_Pdf_Reader/Import_PDF_Reader_Manu.role: Non-AI reader: uploads one PDF, Aspose converts it to .xlsx (Submission/ImportPDFReader/Output), ACE OLEDB reads the sheets, Imp_PDFReader.getCustInvDetls_Excel_Datatable (App_Code) maps them per client. Renames item columns, builds item grid, checks masters with Imp_PDF_Upload flag 'Select_Except_desc_from_Master' and blocks upload if any description is missing from the master. Class is named Import_PDF_Reader.

Import_Pdf_Reader/Import_PDFReader.aspx(.role: Original v1 reader. Posts the PDF to an EC2 OCR service (multipart via WebClient, ApiKey '12345'), fills header + item grid, and on Save inserts General/Invoice/Item; item duty data comes entirely from erm.RetrieveAll_Product_import_PDF_MASTER ('Select_Whole_Data' by importer + part no + description). Items not in master are silently skipped on save.

Import_Pdf_Reader/Imp_Inv_Item_Pdf_Reade.role: Rule-based updater for EXISTING jobs. Reader types: 'Inv Read', 'Item Read', 'Inv & Item Read'; suppliers SUZUKI MOTOR CORPORATION and VESTAS WIND TECHNOLOGY INDIA P.LTD. iTextSharp text extraction with keyword line matching, edit grid, then Import_PDF_Upload procedures Import_Vestas_Inv_item_pdf / Import_Suzuki_Invoice_pdf / Import_Suzuki_Item_pdf (XML payloads). Deletes every file in Submission/ImportPDFReader before each upload.

Export_PDFReader/Export_PDF_Reader.aspx(.role: Oldest export reader for LIZMA-style customers (company ids 1, 10, 517). Only S.P.APPARELS LTD and KPR SUGAR AND APPARELS LIMITED are handled, with hard-coded iTextSharp line parsing ('Inv No.& Date', Buyer's Order No...). Upload calls Exp_PDF_Upload_New_XML flag 'Insert_Desc'. Deletes all files in the shared upload folder first.

Export_PDFReader/Export_PDF_Reader_New.a.role: Template-mapped export reader: Aspose PDF->xlsx->ACE OLEDB (first two sheets only) then EXPORT_PDF_LKUP mapping JSON (Exporter_Name + Invo_Type; 'Shahi Exports Pvt. Ltd.' with several sheets uses type 'M'). Renames item columns by keyword (Kind, Description, Quantity, Rate/Unit/Price, Total/Amount), applies MAF CLOTHING hanger rules, checks the master via Select_Except_desc_from_Master, gets DBK list, then Exp_PDF_Upload_New_XML on save.

Export_PDFReader/Export_XML_JSON_Reader..role: Loads an XML file into a DataSet (tables 0,2,4 = header, invoice, item) and builds the standard grid; invoice value is recomputed from unit price x qty. Save uses Exp_XML_JSON_Upload_New_XML_AI. Counts usage in PDF_AI_COUNT_DETAILS with mode 'EXM' via concatenated raw SQL.

queueLifecycle.jobStatusBadge: Draft while JOB_NO empty or starts with TEMP; Job Saved after Job_No_Update writes the real job no.
timeline: T0 Export AI preview with vendor PMDG: files -> EROYAL message API -> processInstanceId.
T0 Insert_Queue_Record: A1='temp'+JOBNO, A2=file name, A3='EROYAL-'+pdfId, A4=processId, A5=exporter, A16=branch slno, A17=pdf client name, A10='Exp' -> Queue_Insert. Status starts IN PROGRESS.
T0 user is sent to the queue screen (parent.openAistatuscheck('EXP')).
Every 30s (page auto refresh) and on click: EROYAL status check; READY stores OCR JSON in the queue row.
READY: user clicks View, Export AI page renders the stored JSON, user edits and saves; Job_No_Update marks the queue row with the real job number (status badge becomes Job Saved).
FAILED: user must re-upload; Delete Selected removes queue rows.
queueLifecycle.importSide: Only the Export AI page creates queue rows. The IMP toggle, IMP filter and IMP ViewResult route exist but nothing in these three folders inserts IMP rows or consumes ?pid= on the Import AI page.

tablesAndProcs: AI queue table behind AI_Queue (name not visible)
SERVER-side masters via Auto_Search, eroyalmaster, adminmaster, OCR_Pdf_Port_Master, Admin_Premium_Services_Select

security.title: Hard-coded API keys
security.detail: EROYAL_API_KEY 'ATIVSTAGMSNVEHEQAUPMS1CE' in AI_Extraction_Queue_Status.aspx.cs:20 and Export_PDF_Reader_New_AI.aspx.cs:82; ApiKey '12345' / 'Royal' in Import and Export readers.

security.title: SQL injection via string concatenation
security.detail: getlkupval builds SQL with importer/exporter name (Import_Excel_Reader.aspx.cs:1613, Export_PDF_Reader_New.aspx.cs:1556); PDF_AI_COUNT_DETAILS select/insert/update built from job no, importer name and page count (Import_Checklist_Reader_AI.aspx.cs:902-926,1741-1754; Import_Excel_Reader.aspx.cs:1012-1034,2393; Export_XML_JSON_Reader.aspx.cs:613-640). Also DataTable.Select filters built with raw grid text (Import AI SaveCurrentPage/BindgridViewData); Export AI escapes quotes.

security.title: Unsanitised upload file name
security.detail: Path.Combine(folder, uploadedFile.FileName) then SaveAs in all readers; a crafted file name can write outside the upload folder. No file type check on most screens (extension only used for page count).

security.title: Unencrypted external calls
security.detail: Royal OCR and legacy EC2 OCR use http://; customer invoices and CompanyID/UserID are sent in clear.

security.title: Queue actions unauthenticated to the row
security.detail: Delete and View trust IDs posted from the grid; no per-company scoping visible in this code (may exist inside AI_Queue).

correctness.title: Retracted after reading PDF_AI_QUEUE_INSERT_UPDATE_SELECT
correctness.detail: UPDATE_STATUS only overwrites JSON_RESPONSE when the new value is non-empty (CASE WHEN @JSON_RESPONSE != ''), so the A7='' update in gvQueue_RowCommand does NOT wipe stored JSON. The remaining real problem: a manual Check Status click always writes the status it computed, so for a non-EROYAL vendor the Royal path returns IN PROGRESS and could set a READY row back to IN PROGRESS from a stale page.

correctness.title: Transient errors permanently fail a job
correctness.detail: CheckStatus_Eroyal and CheckJobStatus return FAILED on any exception or timeout (lines 343, 392) and the auto refresh writes FAILED to the DB (lines 88-93). A 30s network blip during polling turns a healthy job into FAILED.

correctness.title: Retracted after reading the procedure
correctness.detail: INSERT ignores the JOB_NO passed by the page and generates 'TEMP_' + next number (upper case), so the StartsWith('TEMP') Draft check works.

correctness.title: Import queue path is incomplete
correctness.detail: View routes IMP to Import_PDF_Reader_AI.aspx?pid=... but that page ignores pid/vendor and has no PMDG branch; only Export inserts queue rows. If an Import company were set to vendor PMDG, Get_Upload_File would fall through with an empty ds_API and throw at ds_API.Tables[0].

correctness.title: Royal vendor jobs cannot complete
correctness.detail: ROYAL_STATUS_URL is '' so CheckStatus_Royal always returns IN PROGRESS.

correctness.title: READY with empty OCR result
correctness.detail: If EROYAL reports Completed and ocrReady but ocrResult is empty, status becomes READY without JSON; the Export AI page then shows nothing (Page_Load skips silently when stored JSON is empty).

correctness.title: vendor field is null on later postbacks
correctness.detail: The class field vendor is only set by checkvendor() during Preview. On Upload the guards 'if (vendor != "PMDG")' (Export_PDF_Reader_New_AI.aspx.cs:1653,1934,2750) are therefore always true and PageCount_log passes PDF_VENDOR = null. For queue-opened jobs (vendor came from the query string into a local variable) UPLOAD_* statuses are logged although the code intends to skip them.

correctness.title: Retracted after reading the procedure
correctness.detail: INSERT splits VENDOR_TYPE at the first '-': VENDOR_TYPE stores 'EROYAL' and PDF_ID stores the id, so the exact comparison with 'EROYAL' in the queue page is correct.

correctness.title: Queue row records only the first file
correctness.detail: For multi-file PMDG submissions FILE_NAME stored is uploadedFile.FileName of the first loop item (line 887) while all files are sent as one merged job.

correctness.title: Auto refresh does serial remote calls
correctness.detail: AutoCheckAllInProgressRows loops every IN PROGRESS row (page size 99999) calling EROYAL with a 30s timeout each, inside a page postback and a bare catch{}. Many pending jobs can stall the page well past the 30s refresh cycle.

correctness.title: Shared upload folders are cleared per request
correctness.detail: Import_PDF_Reader_Manual, Imp_Inv_Item_Pdf_Reader, Export_PDF_Reader, Export_PDF_Reader_New delete every file in the shared Submission folder before saving, so two users can destroy each other's uploads. Other readers overwrite by file name and never delete.

correctness.title: Multi-file header overwritten
correctness.detail: Import AI and Export AI (sync path) overwrite header fields (importer, supplier, country, port) with the last file; invoices and items accumulate. hd_PageCount holds only the last PDF's page count.

correctness.title: Export Alert_msg does not escape quotes
correctness.detail: Export_PDF_Reader_New_AI.aspx.cs:735-745 concatenates msg into JS (Import version escapes apostrophes/newlines). Messages containing ' break the alert.

correctness.title: ViewState carries full DataTables
correctness.detail: Item, invoice, container and IGM DataTables (60+ columns, up to hundreds of rows, 1000 in listbox) live in ViewState on every postback, causing very large pages and slow round trips.

correctness.title: Job number allocation side effects unknown
correctness.detail: AUTO_JOBNO()/GENERAL_DETAILS_SP_AUTOID runs on load, at start of save (Import AI line 2115) and after save; whether the procedure consumes a number per call is not visible.

correctness.title: Swallowed errors
correctness.detail: FireAndForget_Eroyal returns '' on any failure with only a log; many helpers use bare catch {} (AutoCheck, CTH/IGST caches, Get_AdCode). Console.WriteLine is used for errors in WebException handlers (nowhere to read under IIS).

correctness.title: Hard-coded business rules everywhere
correctness.detail: COMPANY_IDD and client-name if/else chains (Import ApplyClientOverrides, SetMasterLookupStrategy, Export Getting_Mater_Details/btnupload) and hard-coded lookup tables (BRAKES INDIA, DENSO KIRLOSKAR AdCode/DBK tables, special user names RTS/s/k/Aji/Kavi) make behaviour company-specific and hard to test.

minor: Export_PDF_Reader_New_AI: EroyalCompanyIds unused; Get_Eroyal_API_Output unused; Alert_msg typo 'Getting_Mater_Details' naming.
Import_PDF_Reader_Manual class name 'Import_PDF_Reader' differs from file name; Import_PDFReader derives from System.Web.UI.Page instead of ThemeClass.
UploadPdfWithParameters request stream is not disposed on exceptions (Import AI:1849).
Queue Grid_Total sets lblTotalPages.Text to total row count (name mismatch).
Large commented-out blocks in Manual, Export_PDF_Reader_New and Export_PDF_Reader.

Multiple duplicate helper implementations (Get_Valid_Date, Get_Valid_Qty_Code, Get_Valid_Curr_Name) with slightly different rules per screen (e.g. Export Get_Valid_Date1 returns MM/dd/yyyy while Get_Valid_Date returns dd/MM/yyyy).

howToExtendOrDebug: New AI vendor on Export: add a branch in Export_PDF_Reader_New_AI.btnPrevData_Click and return the Header/ItemsDetails/ShipmentContainerDetails contract above; for async vendors also implement a status check like CheckStatus_Eroyal and store the JSON via Queue_Update_Status.

To finish the Import queue: add Insert_Queue_Record (A10='Imp') in Import AI for vendor PMDG, and read pid/vendor/slno/Imp_exp_name in Import_PDF_Reader_AI.Page_Load to load Queue_Get_By_ProcessId JSON before FillHeaderFields/ProcessItemsBatch.

Where to look when a job stays IN PROGRESS: EROYAL doc for processInstanceId, VENDOR_TYPE value in the queue row, Queue_Update_Status procedure body, PDFReaderLog files in Submission/OCRImpExpLog/<IMP|EXP>/.
Where to look when the grid is empty after View: JSON_RESPONSE column for the pid, Header[0].Status == 'Success', and that ItemsDetails contain non-numeric ItemDesc.
suggestedFixOrder: Move all API keys and endpoint URLs to web.config/secret store; rotate the exposed keys.
Parameterise every raw SQL string and sanitise uploaded file names / restrict extensions.
Make queue polling tolerant: distinguish transient errors from real FAILED, and remove the A7='' overwrite in gvQueue_RowCommand.
Normalise vendor and JOB_NO conventions (EROYAL vs EROYAL-<id>, temp vs TEMP) between Export insert and queue display.
Either finish or hide the Import queue path (pid handling on Import AI).
Store the vendor in ViewState/HiddenField so PMDG guards and PageCount_log are correct after postback.
Give each request its own upload subfolder instead of clearing shared folders.
Move DataTables out of ViewState (session/cache or DB staging table).
